medications.dose: 2.5 mg orally once daily in the morning
medications.purpose: Reduce blood pressure to target <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE inhibitor as first‑line therapy for patients <55 years, non‑Afro‑Caribbean with essential hypertension

assumptions_warnings: NICE NG136 requires baseline renal function (eGFR) and serum potassium before starting an ACE‑I; values not available – assume eGFR ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² and K⁺ ≤4.5 mmol/L.
QRISK cardiovascular risk assessment not available – should be calculated once full lipid profile, smoking status, diabetes status, and family history are obtained.
Allergy status to ACE inhibitors unknown – confirm no prior ACE‑I intolerance before prescribing.
BMI, smoking status, and alcohol intake not recorded – assess and address as part of lifestyle counseling.
treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily as first‑line antihypertensive per NICE NG136, with titration as tolerated and lifelong review. Baseline labs (eGFR, electrolytes, LFTs) and cardiovascular risk assessment should be obtained before dose escalation. Provide lifestyle advice (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight management, limit alcohol, smoking cessation). Follow‑up in 2 weeks to check BP, renal function and potassium, then titrate to 5 mg if needed.
